title_suggestion: What If California Left the Union?
style: Dynamic 3D satellite map with vivid territory highlights, glowing borders, tactical status icons, fast zooms, and animated bold captions over realistic earth textures.
never_change: 3D satellite globe model, tactical icon style, pop-up text graphics.

facts.detail: California declares independence from the United States.
Federal military forces immediately deploy to put down the uprising.
Outmatched Californian troops assume defensive positions and seek foreign support.
Russia supplies financial and military aid to California.
Foreign aid helps Californian forces push back federal troops.
US deploys troops to Texas and Florida to prevent further secessions.
Californian forces exploit US distraction to capture the western half of the nation.
Russia takes advantage of US weakness to invade and occupy Alaska.
US offers peace, but continued Californian advances force full US surrender and recognition of California's western territory.

points: US federal military deploys to suppress the movement.
clips.visual: Zoom into California highlighted in red, followed by military helmet icons appearing along borders.

points: Californian forces defend while seeking global allies.
Russia provides financial support to California.
clips.visual: Camera shifts across California showing defense icons, then pans to Russia highlighted in red with dollar symbols.

points: Russian support enables California to repel federal forces.
US worries about additional state rebellions.
clips.visual: California red zone expands outward; shocked emoji appears over the US heartland.

points: US sends forces to contain potential revolts in Texas and Florida.
California takes advantage to seize the western territory.
clips.visual: Map pans across southern states with troop icons, then zooms west as red zone covers western US.

points: Russia exploits US turmoil to invade Alaska.
Alaska falls under Russian control without defense.
clips.visual: Camera shifts north to Alaska as Russian red overlay covers the region.

points: Distressed US attempts to negotiate peace.
Continued Californian push forces US surrender and loss of the West Coast.
clips.visual: Meme graphic appears over US map, followed by handshake icon, east expansion, white flag, and new border label.

coverage: Every listed fact appears in exactly one clip.
notes: Timestamps are estimated based on rapid scene transitions.
